rapport_notes: Warm, familiar tone with a repeat customer; flexible and low-friction about capturing details a different way.

evidence_quotes.agenda: Not asked -- follow-up call on a submitted online inquiry from a repeat customer.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: N/A -- call never reached a full price quote; rep confirmed only estimated hours (8.5 hrs, 2 movers) pending an inventory list/photos, no differentiator pitch delivered.

top_strength: Offered a flexible, low-friction way to capture accurate inventory via a photo/video upload link when the customer didn't have a list ready, and adjusted the hours estimate down from the prior move's duration to account for no packing service this time.
coaching_note: Never delivered the value differentiators (damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee) even though a soft booking was made -- still worth walking through before finalizing.
